name: SpinCAM 0.9.11
notes: Drawn cups: each pass lifts off where the metal meets the mandrel; neck swept or stretch by stretch (a choice); the simulation treats the cup as a cylinder. Collisions fixed (tailstock pad, flared mandrel ends, tight pockets). Long plans in the background: the window never freezes. Pass plan in clear groups; five steps. Thinning limit. Every G-code program checked against its plan for every controller.
